text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service=infra-inference-prod (service_id: svc_0a9f). Trigger: high 5xx ratio (>6%) across inference-api-prod routes. Escalation policy: Redwood Oncall -> page delivered to schedule 'infra-team'. Link: https://pagerduty.example/alerts/PD-98765
Sam: Acked. I got the page but this looks wrong - infra-team doesn't own the model-serving routes. Checking.
Leah: I saw the same. The PD service bound is 'infra-inference-prod' but our load balancer list shows requests failing on pods labeled app=inference-api. Could be a service->schedule mapping mismatch.
Mike: Did PD send the payload? can we see the webhook/body to know which routing key triggered it?
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty webhook payload attached:
```
{
  "alert_id": "PD-98765",
  "service": {"id":"svc_0a9f","name":"infra-inference-prod"},
  "incident_key": "high-5xx-inference-2026-04-01",
  "trigger_condition": "5xx_rate > 6%",
  "links": ["https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PD-98765"]
}
```
Sam: Looks like the PD service is misnamed; infra-inference-prod should route to infra-systems schedule, not the inference oncall. So alert went to infra instead of inference. We need to rebind to service_id svc_1b2c which maps to inference-prod schedule.
Leah: I'm on the PD console now. I can change the service for this incident to the correct one and reassign escalation. Doing it now.
Leah: (action) edited incident -> changed service to inference-serving-prod (svc_1b2c) and re-routed to 'inference-oncall' schedule. Update in PD: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PD-98765/changes
pagerduty-bot: Incident updated: service changed to inference-serving-prod; new escalation notified.
Sam: Thanks. @Maya can you take the follow-up and assess customer impact? I'm going to look at pod logs and check if rollback/scale is needed.
Maya: Looking at SLO dashboard — error rate spiked for 12 minutes, ~4% of requests were 5xx (short window) but top customers show increased latency. Not all requests failed; some retries succeeded. Impact: possible tokenization edgecases on a new model rollout.
Mike: If it's rollout-related, can we temporarily pin model version or scale replicas to reduce error rate?
Sam: I'm going to scale inference deployment to 6 -> 12 replicas to absorb load while we investigate. Running:
```
kubectl -n prod scale deploy inference-api --replicas=12
```
Sam: scaling... pods creating. logs show OOM in one replica right before spike:
```
E0421 12:03:45 pod/inference-5fd7 OOMKilled memory exceed on container runtime
```
Leah: That aligns with rollout of a larger model (quantized config not applied). We probably have a model config mismatch on the new image that increases memory.
Maya: For customer comms: I recommend noting transient errors, we've mitigated by scaling and rerouting the alert to the right oncall. No data loss. Tentative severity: Sev2 until trend confirms.
Sam: Agreed. I've pinned the deployment to previous image tag to stop the bad rollout:
```
kubectl -n prod set image deploy/inference-api inference-api=registry.redwood/inference-api:stable-20260328
```
Sam: image rollback applied, new pods healthy, 2xx rates climbing back to baseline.
Leah: Quick note for PagerDuty config owners: the PD service 'infra-inference-prod' was a duplicate created during a migration in 2025 and the alert rule uses that service id. We should consolidate and remove duplicates to avoid future misrouting.
Mike: I'll open a cleanup ticket and add a PD audit task.
Leah: Filed PD cleanup: https://issues.redwood/example/PD-cleanup-142 (assigning to Platform/Oncall config).
Maya: Customer message draft: "We experienced elevated 5xx errors affecting inference API for ~15 minutes due to a model rollout memory regression. We have rolled back the model and scaled instances while we validate. No user data was lost; requests have returned to normal. We're investigating root cause and will follow up."
Sam: Nice. I'll post that to status.redwood and mark incident as mitigated once we watch stability for 30m.
pagerduty-bot: Incident PD-98765 acknowledged by Sam and assigned to inference-oncall.
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident mitigated - monitoring. Please add postmortem notes to the ticket and include PagerDuty duplicative services in the RCA.
Leah: Action items: 1) Consolidate PD services and update alert rules (Leah) 2) Add model rollout memory test to CI (Mike) 3) Improve oncall routing validation checks (Sam) 4) Customer comms and postmortem (Maya). I'll create a short runbook entry for detecting PD routing duplicates.
Sam: thanks all, closing thread in 30m if no regression. :thumbsup:
